content:
Instructions: This form should be completed by the employee planning to resign from their position at RUA Company Glass & Aluminum. Please submit the completed form to your direct Manager and the HR Department. Your resignation is subject to the notice period outlined in your employment contract and UAE Labour Law.

Section 1: Employee Details

  • Employee Full Name: {{employee_full_name}}

  • Employee ID Number: {{employee_id}}

  • Job Title: {{employee_position}}

  • Date of Joining RUA Company: {{date_of_joining}}
    (DD/MM/YYYY)

Section 2: Resignation Details

  • Date of Submitting this Form: ____ /____ /________ (DD/MM/YYYY) (This is the date your notice period typically begins)

  • Proposed Last Day of Work: ____ /____ /________ (DD/MM/YYYY) (Note: Your final last day will be confirmed by HR based on your contractual notice period)

  • Notice Period (as per your contract): ________ Days / Months (Please specify)

Section 3: Reason for Leaving (Optional)

  • Providing a reason helps us understand employee experiences and improve. Your response is valuable but optional.

    • [ ] Found a new job opportunity

    • [ ] Relocating (Internationally / Domestically)

    • [ ] Career Change / Different Industry

    • [ ] Further Education / Training

    • [ ] Personal / Family Reasons

    • [ ] Retirement

    • [ ] Seeking better compensation/benefits

    • [ ] Concerns with work environment / role / management (Optional: Specify briefly ____________________)

    • [ ] End of Contract (If applicable)

    • [ ] Other (Please specify briefly): _________________________

  • Would you be open to participating in an Exit Interview to discuss your experience at RUA Company? [ ] Yes [ ] No

Section 4: Forwarding Contact Information (Post-Employment)

  • This information is needed for sending your final settlement, experience letter, and any other necessary documents after your departure.

  • Personal Email Address: _________________________

  • Personal Mobile Number: _________________________

  • Forwarding Address (if applicable, e.g., for couriering documents): _________________________________________________________

Section 5: Employee Acknowledgements

  • Please read and sign below to acknowledge your understanding:

    • I confirm my intention to resign from my position at RUA Company Glass & Aluminum effective as per the confirmed last working day.

    • I understand my resignation is subject to the notice period stipulated in my employment contract and in accordance with UAE Labour Law.

    • I commit to cooperating fully with my manager and colleagues to ensure a smooth handover of my duties, responsibilities, company documents, and information before my departure.

    • I acknowledge that I must return all company property in my possession (e.g., ID card, access keys, laptop, mobile phone, tools, equipment, safety gear, company vehicle, documents, data, etc.) on or before my last working day as part of the clearance process.

    • I understand that my final settlement (including End of Service Benefit/Gratuity, final salary, payment for accrued unused leave, minus any applicable deductions like outstanding loans or damages) will be processed according to UAE Labour Law and company policy, typically after successful completion of the clearance process.

    • I understand I must coordinate with the HR department / Company PRO regarding the necessary procedures for my employment visa cancellation or transfer (if applicable).
